title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a real-video example for Session 1 (marble on a table)
body:
## Problem
Session 1 uses synthetic frames only; students ask how to do the same with their own phone video.

## Context
The experiment paragraph in Section E suggests rolling a marble past a phone camera.

## Expected outcome
A short guide in `sessions/session-01/` with a script that cuts one row from every frame of a video (for example with imageio or OpenCV, listed as optional) and saves the kymograph.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/lesson.py`, `sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Works on a 5 second sample video
- [ ] Optional dependency documented, base tests still pass without it

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: separate moving from static stripes
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet; a static background biases the slope.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`, Session 4. Students ask why a fixed bright edge ruins the measurement.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 5: velocity scan for stripes in both directions
body:
## Problem
The shipped estimators return one speed; a kymograph with stripes in two directions gives a meaningless value near zero.

## Context
Roadmap Session 5.

## Expected outcome
A lesson and app where the learner scans candidate slopes and sees a peak for each dominant velocity.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Both velocities found within 0.05 on the roadmap example
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: a kymograph that measures itself
body:
## Problem
The Target animation builds a kymograph line by line and reports the flow speed; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Roadmap checkpoints for static background, two directions and noise are met
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
